spec.expr: max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{platform="pve"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left node_hwmon_sensor_label{platform="pve",label="Tctl"}) or max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{platform="pve"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left node_hwmon_sensor_label{platform="pve",label="Package id 0"}) or max by (instance) (nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu{platform="pve"}) or max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{platform="pve"} * on (instance, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{platform="pve",chip_name="k10temp"}) or max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{platform="pve"} * on (instance, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{platform="pve",chip_name="cpu_thermal"})

(95 - max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{platform="pve"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left node_hwmon_sensor_label{platform="pve",label="Tctl"})) or (max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_crit_celsius{platform="pve"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left node_hwmon_sensor_label{platform="pve",label="Package id 0"}) - max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{platform="pve"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left node_hwmon_sensor_label{platform="pve",label="Package id 0"})) or max by (instance) (nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu_tlimit{platform="pve"}) or (95 - max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{platform="pve"} * on (instance, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{platform="pve",chip_name="k10temp"})) or (85 - max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{platform="pve"} * on (instance, chip) group_left node_hwmon_chip_names{platform="pve",chip_name="cpu_thermal"}))

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU in use on each machine of one platform.

spec.title: Guests
spec.description: Every virtual machine and container, where it runs and what it uses of what it was given.

spec.expr: max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_up) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))
100 * max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

clamp_max(100 * max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})) / max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})), 100)
max by (name) (max by (id) (pve_uptime_seconds) * on (id) group_left(name) max by (id, name) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

spec.title: Storage pools
spec.description: How full each storage pool is. A pool shared by every node is shown once.

spec.expr: sort_desc(100 * max by (node, storage) (label_mismatch(max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} > 0)) * on (id) group_left(storage, node, plugintype) max by (id, storage, node, plugintype) (pve_storage_info), "plugintype", "nfs")) or label_set(100 * max by (storage) (label_match(max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} > 0)) * on (id) group_left(storage, node, plugintype) max by (id, storage, node, plugintype) (pve_storage_info), "plugintype", "nfs")), "node", "shared"))

spec.title: Recent warnings and errors
spec.description: Journal lines from the PVE nodes at warning level and above, newest first, each led by its node and service. Login sessions are left out; Explore has them.

spec.expr: service.namespace:=pve severity_number:>=13 -systemd.unit:~"^user@" | format if (severity_number:range[13, 16]) "warning" as level | format if (severity_number:range[17, 20]) "error" as level | format if (severity_number:range[21, 24]) "critical" as level | format "<host.name> <service.name>: <_msg>" as _msg

spec.title: Drives · solid state
spec.description: What each NVMe drive says about itself, the same on every platform. Temperature turns red at 78 °C, near where each drive's alert fires: 5 °C under its own warning temperature, 77.85 °C on a Spark and 78.85 °C on the others. It turns orange 10 °C before.

spec.title: Recent warnings and errors
spec.description: Journal lines from the Sparks at warning level and above, newest first, each led by its Spark and service. Login sessions and Bluetooth are left out, because every SSH login starts desktop services that warn and re-register Bluetooth profiles; Explore has them. Containers, inference included, log to Docker rather than the journal, so their output is not here.

spec.expr: service.namespace:=spark severity_number:>=13 -systemd.unit:~"^user@" -service.name:=bluetooth | format if (severity_number:range[13, 16]) "warning" as level | format if (severity_number:range[17, 20]) "error" as level | format if (severity_number:range[21, 24]) "critical" as level | format "<host.name> <service.name>: <_msg>" as _msg

spec.title: Drives · solid state
spec.description: What each NVMe drive says about itself, the same on every platform. Temperature turns red at 78 °C, near where each drive's alert fires: 5 °C under its own warning temperature, 77.85 °C on a Spark and 78.85 °C on the others. It turns orange 10 °C before.
